question: What exact-match outputs does a user-configured live provider return for a few arithmetic prompts?
hypothesis: Simple arithmetic prompts can expose response differences, but this probe cannot establish comparative model quality.
controls: No retries added by the benchmark
Explicit --live opt-in with a three-request hard cap
All model responses omitted from stored report for privacy
limitations: Responses vary by service time, sampling, backend changes, rate limits and model routing.
The active model may not permit a reproducible seed or identical sampling settings.
Different providers can have different token accounting, tokenizer and output format behavior.
No provider-billed cost is calculated; missing cost is N/A even if the model is advertised free.
Three arithmetic prompts are not a representative LLM benchmark; compare multiple runs and disclose all conditions.
